--- create_vector_index_extra_key_columns.sql
CREATE VECTOR INDEX Singer_vector_index ON Singers(embedding, tenant_id, category)
OPTIONS(distance_type = 'COSINE')

--- AST
&ast.CreateVectorIndex{
  Name: &ast.Ident{
    NamePos: 20,
    NameEnd: 39,
    Name:    "Singer_vector_index",
  },
  TableName: &ast.Ident{
    NamePos: 43,
    NameEnd: 50,
    Name:    "Singers",
  },
  ColumnName: &ast.Ident{
    NamePos: 51,
    NameEnd: 60,
    Name:    "embedding",
  },
  ExtraKeyColumns: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 62,
      NameEnd: 71,
      Name:    "tenant_id",
    },
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 73,
      NameEnd: 81,
      Name:    "category",
    },
  },
  Options: &ast.Options{
    Options: 83,
    Rparen:  115,
    Records: []*ast.OptionsDef{
      &ast.OptionsDef{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 91,
          NameEnd: 104,
          Name:    "distance_type",
        },
        Value: &ast.StringLiteral{
          ValuePos: 107,
          ValueEnd: 115,
          Value:    "COSINE",
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE VECTOR INDEX Singer_vector_index ON Singers (embedding, tenant_id, category) OPTIONS (distance_type = "COSINE")
